parties.respondent: Office Of Lieutenant Governor Of Delhi

summary: Interpretation of powers under Delhi Municipal Corporation Act vis-à-vis Article 239AA of Constitution; whether Lt. Governor must act on aid and advice of Council of Ministers in nominating members to DMC; reliance on Samsher Singh and Constitution Bench decisions; established practice of nominations by Lt. Governor acting on Council's advice; statutory duty of Lt. Governor under Section 3(3)(b)(i) DMC Act interpreted within framework of collective ministerial responsibility; nominations quashed for non-compliance with constitutional norms.
legal_provisions_cited: Government of National Capital Territory Act, 1991 s.41
Samsher Singh v. State of Punjab
State (NCT of Delhi) v. Union of India
Government of NCT of Delhi v. Union of India
final_judgment: Writ petition allowed; notifications dated 03.01.2023 and 04.01.2023 quashed; Lt. Governor directed to act on aid and advice of Council of Ministers for future nominations.
